description: This file defines the NationalityModel class within the OrangeHRM project. The class implements the Normalizable interface and uses traits to facilitate serialization and normalization of Nationality entity objects. It sets up entity filters and attribute names relevant to the Nationality model.

classes.name: NationalityModel
classes.description: Represents a serializable model for the Nationality entity in the OrangeHRM system, facilitating normalization and serialization of nationality data.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the NationalityModel with a Nationality entity and sets up relevant filters and attribute names.
